reviews.comment: The class is not at bad as some of the reviews say, Prof Mehlhaf let you use AI on all the coding, which helped me become a better r markdown user, he was strict on it, but just do what he asks when you use Ai. Work in groups for problem sets, they were easy regardless. It's a hard class, but if I can get an A+ you can you!

If there weren't attendance quizzes, not showing up would not hurt you). He has a very anal AI policy that hurt a majority of the class when they were not misusing AI. You're final paper will be built throughout the year in 5 sections, but you'll have to swift through them for the final paper instead of correcting them and putting them together.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Most of the work was coding and in class participation through polls. The lectures were tolerable however had nothing to do with the work and the TA was awful. She decides 78% of the grade and barely understood basic english. Be wary of the TA and learn to code in R-script

Professor was a chiller. Considering the course difficulty, prof Mehlhaff was a great professor and the best option for 309. The problem sets were completely doable, drops your lowest. Capstone heavy but no reason you shouldn't get an A if you followed the rubric/ directions. Would recommend.
